purpose: Central-bank mandates, monetary operations, transmission, crisis facilities, governance, and effects in named jurisdictions.
editorial_principles: Use a named jurisdiction, population, and date where applicable.
Present comparisons on equal terms and label illustrative scenarios.
Verify primary sources and current guidance before production.
Separate central banks from retail banks and other regulators; date policy claims and avoid individualized financial advice.

angles.angle: Why a Central Bank Was Established
angles.scope: Use the founding law and contemporary debates for a named jurisdiction.
angles.question: Which problem was one central bank created to address?
angles.evidence: founding law, dated monetary-policy statements and minutes, official facility terms, central-bank accounts, and independently sourced macroeconomic data
angles.boundary: Separate central banks from retail banks and other regulators; date policy claims and avoid individualized financial advice.
